features.title: Why Choose TutorAI
features.subtitle: Cutting-edge technology for the education of the future

items.title: Advanced Cognitive Analysis
items.description: AI analyzes your learning style and creates a personalized path that adapts to your specific needs.
items.detailedDescription: TutorAI uses advanced machine learning algorithms to analyze your cognitive style, gaps, and strengths. The AI creates a unique learning profile that is constantly updated based on your progress. This allows customization of every lesson, exercise, and explanation to maximize your understanding and retention.

items.title: Intelligent Gap Recovery
items.description: Automatically identifies and fills gaps in your knowledge, building a solid foundation for the future.
items.detailedDescription: The system automatically identifies gaps in your knowledge through intelligent diagnostic tests and performance analysis. Once identified, TutorAI creates a targeted recovery path that fills these gaps progressively and logically. This approach ensures there are no 'holes' in your preparation that could compromise future learning.

items.title: Realistic Test Simulations
items.description: Face tests with confidence thanks to simulations that perfectly replicate the exam environment.
items.detailedDescription: TutorAI creates test simulations that faithfully replicate the exam environment, including difficulty levels, timing, and question types. This allows you to familiarize yourself with the format and reduce performance anxiety. The simulations are adaptive: if you make mistakes, the system provides detailed explanations and suggests similar exercises to reinforce understanding.

items.title: Anxiety and Stress Management
items.description: Relaxation techniques and mental strategies to serenely face every academic challenge.
items.detailedDescription: TutorAI includes specific modules for managing study-related anxiety and stress. Through breathing techniques, mindfulness, and coping strategies, the system helps you maintain calm and focus. These tools are particularly useful before important exams or when tackling complex topics.

items.title: School Support Network
items.description: Connect with a community of students and receive support when you need it.
items.detailedDescription: TutorAI is not just an AI: it's part of a complete educational ecosystem. You can connect with other students facing the same challenges, share study strategies, and receive moral support. The platform also includes access to specialized human tutors for when you need additional personalized support.

items.title: Monitored Progress
items.description: Track your improvements with detailed analytics and celebrate every milestone achieved.
items.detailedDescription: TutorAI's advanced tracking system monitors every aspect of your learning: time dedicated, topics completed, performance improvements, and skills acquired. This data is presented through intuitive dashboards that help you visualize your progress and stay motivated in your study journey.

faq.title: Questions? We have answers.
faq.subtitle: The most frequently asked questions to immediately start the revolution of your study.

items.question: What is TutorAI in practice?
items.answer: It's your personal tutor available 24/7. It's not a database of videos or exercises, but an artificial intelligence that dialogues with you, understands your difficulties and creates explanations, exercises and study plans tailored to you, in real time.

items.question: We are in beta phase, what does this mean for me?
items.answer: It means you'll have early and free access to the platform in exchange for your feedback. You'll help us perfect the service before the official launch. Spots are limited to ensure high quality support for each beta tester.

items.question: Does it replace a teacher or tutoring?
items.answer: TutorAI is designed to be a powerful support tool that accompanies daily study. It replaces traditional tutoring by offering a more economical, always available and totally personalized alternative that adapts to the student's pace.
